description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2018 World Championships, built on Buzzwole-GX and Lycanroc-GX. The 2018 World Championships were held at the Music City Center in Nashville, Tennessee, from 24 to 26 August 2018.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2018 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box, a pin and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
